name: Auto Download Buttons
author: cpmehula

sections.description:
Auto Download Buttons is a feature-rich and highly customizable WordPress plugin that allows you to easily embed stylish download buttons with a crucial feature: a delayed auto-download timer. This is the perfect solution for protecting content, ensuring users view necessary information before accessing a file, and providing a clean, polished user experience for digital downloads.

Key Features:

  • Deep Styling Controls: Customize button background colors for Ready, Hover, and Waiting states, along with text color and border radius.
  • Custom Countdown Logic: Set a mandatory countdown and define the exact waiting message (using the {seconds} placeholder).
  • File Information Flashcard: Dynamic element automatically detects the file extension (e.g., XLSX, PDF) and displays it with a custom background and text color.
  • Shortcode Integration: Simple shortcode [auto-download-button] that can be embedded anywhere.
  • Download Filename Customization: Use the download_name attribute to override the original server filename.
  • Global Settings: Easy-to-use Admin Settings panel for setting defaults which can be overridden by shortcode attributes.
sections.installation:
1. Simple Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Search for “Auto Download Buttons”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

2. Usage

  1. Configure your default style and behavior settings under Auto Download Buttons in your WordPress admin menu.

  2. Use the shortcode in any post, page, or widget where you want to display the button:

    [auto-download-button url=”[Your File URL]” time=”10″ download_name=”My-Custom-File.xlsx”]

Shortcode Attributes

Attribute
Description
Required?
Example

url
The direct link to your downloadable file.
Yes
url="https://domain.com/files/sheet.xlsx"

time
The countdown delay in seconds. Overrides the global setting.
No
time="5"

download_name
The custom name the downloaded file will have on the user’s computer.
No
download_name="Budget-Template.xlsx"
sections.faq:
Q: Where can I customize the button colors and waiting text?

A: All global defaults, including styling and countdown messages, can be customized under the dedicated Auto Download Buttons menu in your WordPress admin dashboard. (See Screenshots 1 & 2).

Q: What is the “Flashcard”?

A: The Flashcard is the small, stylized element above the button text (like the XLSX badge you see in Screenshot 3). You can customize its color, text size, and border radius in the plugin settings.

Q: How do I make the countdown work?

A: Set the Default Countdown Time (Seconds) and Default Waiting Text in the settings. Ensure your waiting text includes the {seconds} placeholder, as shown in Screenshot 2, to display the live countdown.
